Several weeks (you can only hand in 1 tome every 20 hours)

The dwarf {npc:Cael}, sage of Farmine, wants to learn everything about the continent of Zao. Scattered around Zao are 12 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge}: most are found during the missions of other Zao quests. Each tome you hand him unlocks something new: decorations and backpacks for sale, trades with NPCs, the serpent teleport and access to the Corruption Hole and the Zao Palace.
Dragon Tapestries, Minotaur Backpacks and Dragon Backpacks for sale from Pompan
Dragon Tapestry with **1** tome handed in, Minotaur Backpack with **2** and Dragon Backpack with **5**.
Lizard Weapon Rack for sale from Esrik
Rice trade with Swolt (Bunch of Ripe Rice for 10 Rice Balls)
War Drums and Didgeridoo for sale from Cael
It is one-way only: it takes you to the Muggy Plains teleport, south of the Dragonblaze Peaks.
You also need to have finished {wiki:The New Frontier Quest|The New Frontier Quest}.
Dragon Statue and Dragon Throne made by Cael
Dragon Statue with **11** tomes (in exchange for a {item:Red Lantern}); Dragon Throne with **12** (in exchange for a {item:Red Piece of Cloth}).
